runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential clang python3 python3-pip && test -x /usr/bin/clang && test -x /usr/bin/clang++ && printf '[global]\nbreak-system-packages = true\n' > /etc/pip.conf && python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'pyyaml==6.0.3' 'numpy==2.5.3' 'pytest==9.0.3' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
